name: Triangle / Box Overlap Test (Conservative 26/6-separating)
definition: An overlap test to determine if an axis-aligned box overlaps a triangle. For fully conservative 26-separating rasterization, it checks if the triangle plane intersects the box and checks 2D projections along all three axes. For thin 6-separating case, it checks projection along the dominant axis of the triangle normal.
summary: This conservative test ensures gap-free voxel coverage by decomposing 3D overlap into a plane check and three 2D projections, requiring fewer GPU instructions than the standard Separating Axis Theorem.
